error.summary: Two demonstrated defects: answer-bank shapes bypass the intended reasoning, including all five delivered batch records; three supplied source cases are rejected. Package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Infer rank or nullity from a space description, identify the column count, and apply rank + nullity = n.
reasoning_steps: Easy: count the column-space basis vectors to obtain rank, then subtract from the column count.
Moderate: identify the dimension of the parameterized null space, then subtract from the vector component count.
Select the resulting integer from five radio choices.
invariants: Basis cardinality must be feasible for the matrix dimensions.
Prompts, answer keys and worked solutions must describe the same instance.
permitted_variations: Vary feasible matrix dimensions and basis cardinality.
Vary coefficient values and parameter supports within the source workload.
Include source-supported four- and five-component null-space vectors.
Vary which numeric option qualifies without exposing it through incidental bank shapes.
source_refs: Tutorial 0728c510-110b-5bde-93ea-9050a87a6ecc: rank(A) + nullity(A) = n; n is the number of vector components

findings.description: Recognizable answer-bank shapes reveal the qualifying numeric option. The gap pattern 2,1,1,1 always identifies the second-smallest option: 16/16 raw and 15/15 delivered sampled cases. Additional bank-only rules answer all five exact batch records. UI option shuffling does not defeat numeric-order strategies.
